comment: Showcase tasks for free-mode scene building (examples/scenes_free/run_all.py). Only the task text goes to the model; it picks the robot and writes the scene. `turns` is the solve budget, `blender` marks the task rendered with Blender.

tasks.name: cable_lift
tasks.text: lift the cable off the table by both of its ends, using two arms

tasks.name: cloth_drape
tasks.text: drape the cloth over the box

tasks.name: rope_line
tasks.text: lay the rope straight along the white line on the table

tasks.name: rope_ring
tasks.text: thread the end of the rope through the ring

tasks.name: hinged_lid
tasks.text: open the hinged lid of the box
